reservations.question: How do reservations work?
reservations.answer: If a book is checked out, you can reserve it and you'll be notified as soon as it's back on the shelf.

seatBookings.question: How do seat bookings work?
seatBookings.answer: Pick an open time slot on the seat map and it's held for you until your session starts.

donations.question: Can I donate books?
donations.answer: Yes, submit a donation request and our team will review and approve it for the shared collection.

aiRecommendations.question: What is AI Recommendations?
aiRecommendations.answer: A conversational assistant that recommends books based on your interests, mood, or reading history.

whyLonger.heading: Why choose a longer plan?
whyLonger.subheading: Every plan unlocks the same features — a longer commitment just means more savings and less to think about.

upgrade.question: Can I upgrade my subscription later?
upgrade.answer: Yes, you can move to a longer plan at any time and we'll prorate the difference.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Absolutely — there are no long-term contracts or cancellation fees.

discount.question: Do you provide educational discounts?
discount.answer: Yes, accredited colleges and universities qualify for additional discounts on top of the plan savings.

support.question: Is customer support included?
support.answer: Yes, all plans include support, and the 6-month and 12-month plans include priority support.

switchLonger.question: Can I switch to a longer subscription later?
switchLonger.answer: Yes, you can switch to a longer plan whenever you're ready, and your remaining time will be credited.

freeTrial.question: Is there a free trial?
freeTrial.answer: This preview lets you explore every feature before choosing a plan — no credit card required.
